name: Asha
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c136574]Kyra[/url] is her older sister

A leader of one of the gangs of Raiders, she's the younger sibling to Kyra, the top dog in her group.

As far as I know, Adira is a chaotic mess of a place, where different raider gangs control different parts of the town. The two sisters have carved their control over one of those gangs in blood. Between the two, she's the wildcat, the enforcer.

Pone to violence and truly embracing the raider lifestyle, she always goes all in and doesn't seem to know when to use her head.
